40022331.author: पदार्थः
40022331.content: ततः then, द्वादशमे in the twelfth, वर्षे year, शत्रघ्नः Shatrughna, रामपालिताम् protected by Rama, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, चकमे desired, गन्तुम् to go, अल्पभृत्यबलानुगः accompanied by a small retinue of servants and army.

40022331.author: Translation
40022331.content: Then, in the twelfth year, Shatrughna, accompanied by a small retinue of servants and army, desired to go to Ayodhya, which was protected by Rama.

40022332.author: पदार्थः
40022332.content: ततः then, मन्त्रिपुरोगांश्च and the chief ministers, बलमुख्यान्निवर्त्य having sent back the chief commanders, च and, जगाम went, हयमुख्यैश्च and with excellent horses, रथानाम् of chariots, च and, शतेन with a hundred, सः he.

40022332.author: Translation
40022332.content: Then, having sent back his chief ministers and military commanders, he proceeded with excellent horses and a hundred chariots.

40022333.author: पदार्थः
40022333.content: सः he, गत्वा having gone, गणितान्वासान् counted days of travel, सप्ताष्टौ seven or eight, रघुनन्दनः the delight of the Raghus, वाल्मीक्याश्रममागत्य having come to Valmiki's hermitage, वासम् stay, चक्रे made, महायशाः the greatly renowned.

40022333.author: Translation
40022333.content: Having traveled for seven or eight counted days, the greatly renowned Shatrughna, the delight of the Raghus, arrived at Valmiki's hermitage and made his stay there.

40022334.author: पदार्थः
40022334.content: सः he, अभिवाद्य having saluted, ततः then, पादौ feet, वाल्मीकेः of Valmiki, पुरुषर्षभः the best among men, पाद्यम् water for washing feet, अर्ध्यम् water for respectful offering, तथातिथ्यम् and hospitality, जग्राह accepted, मुनिहस्ततः from the hand of the sage.

40022334.author: Translation
40022334.content: Then, the best among men, Shatrughna, having saluted Valmiki's feet, accepted the water for washing feet, the respectful offering, and the hospitality from the sage's hand.

40022335.author: पदार्थः
40022335.content: बहुरूपाः of many forms, सुमधुराः very sweet, कथाः stories, तत्र there, सहस्रशः in thousands, कथयामास narrated, सः that, मुनिः sage, शत्रुघ्नाय to Shatrughna, महात्मने to the great-souled one.

40022335.author: Translation
40022335.content: That sage narrated thousands of stories, varied in form and very sweet, to the great-souled Shatrughna.

40022336.author: पदार्थः
40022336.content: उवाच spoke, च and, मुनिः the sage, वाक्यम् words, लवणस्य of Lavana, वधाश्रितम् related to the killing, सुदुष्करम् very difficult, कृतम् done, कर्म deed, लवणम् Lavana, निघ्नता by one who killed, त्वया by you.

40022336.author: Translation
40022336.content: And the sage spoke words concerning the killing of Lavana, saying that the deed of killing Lavana, which you accomplished, was extremely arduous.

40022337.author: पदार्थः
40022337.content: बहवः many, पार्थिवाः kings, सौम्य O gentle one, हताः killed, सबलवाहनाः with their armies and vehicles, लवणेन by Lavana, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, युध्यमानाः fighting, महाबलाः very powerful.

40022337.author: Translation
40022337.content: O gentle and mighty-armed one, many very powerful kings, along with their armies and vehicles, were killed by Lavana while fighting him.

40022338.author: पदार्थः
40022338.content: सः that, त्वया by you, निहतः killed, पापः wicked one, लीलया with ease, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men, जगतः of the world, च and, भयम् fear, तत्र there, प्रशान्तम् pacified, तव your, तेजसा by valor.

40022338.author: Translation
40022338.content: O best among men, that wicked one was killed by you with ease, and the fear of the world was pacified by your valor.

40022339.author: पदार्थः
40022339.content: रावणस्य of Ravana, वधः the killing, घोरः terrible, यत्नेन with effort, महता great, कृतः done, इदम् this, तु but, सुमहत्कर्म very great deed, त्वया by you, कृतम् done, अयत्नतः effortlessly.

40022339.author: Translation
40022339.content: The terrible killing of Ravana was accomplished with great effort, but this very great deed was done by you effortlessly.

40022340.author: पदार्थः
40022340.content: प्रीतिः joy, च and, अस्मिन् in this matter, परा great, जाता arose, देवानां of the gods, लवणे Lavana, हते having been killed, भूतानां of beings, च and, एव indeed, सर्वेषां of all, जगतः of the world, च and, प्रियं good, कृतम् was done.

40022340.author: Translation
40022340.content: Upon Lavana's death, great joy arose among the gods and all beings, and good was done for the entire world.

40022341.author: पदार्थः
40022341.content: तत् that, च and, युद्धं battle, मया by me, दृष्टं was seen, यथावत् properly, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men, सभायां in the assembly, वासवस्य of Vasava (Indra), अथ then, उपविष्टेन by one seated, राघव O Raghava.

40022341.author: Translation
40022341.content: O best among men, O Raghava, that battle was seen by me exactly as it happened, while I was seated in the assembly of Indra.

40022342.author: पदार्थः
40022342.content: मम my, अपि also, परमा supreme, प्रीतिः joy, हृदि in the heart, शत्रुघ्न O Shatrughna, वर्तते exists, उपाघ्रास्यामि I will smell/kiss, ते your, मूर्ध्नि on the head, स्नेहस्य of affection, एषा this, परा supreme, गतिः expression.

40022342.author: Translation
40022342.content: O Shatrughna, supreme joy also resides in my heart, and I will kiss your head, for this is the highest expression of affection.

40022343.author: पदार्थः
40022343.content: इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, मूर्ध्नि on the head, शत्रुघ्नम् Shatrughna, उपाघ्राय having kissed, महामुनिः the great sage, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, अकरोत् offered, तस्य to him, ये who, च and, तस्य his, पदानुगाः followers.

40022343.author: Translation
40022343.content: Having thus spoken and kissed Shatrughna on the head, the great sage offered hospitality to him and his followers.

40022344.author: पदार्थः
40022344.content: सः he, भुक्तवान् having eaten, नरश्रेष्ठः the best among men, गीतमाधुर्यम् the sweetness of the song, उत्तमम् excellent, शुश्राव heard, रामचरितं the deeds of Rama, तस्मिन् in that, काले time, यथाकृमम् in due order.

40022344.author: Translation
40022344.content: After eating, the best among men, Shatrughna, heard the excellent sweetness of the song narrating the deeds of Rama, in due order at that time.

40022345.author: पदार्थः
40022345.content: तन्त्रीलयसमायुक्तं endowed with the rhythm of string instruments, त्रिस्थानकरणान्वितम् accompanied by actions in three registers, संस्कृतं refined, लक्षणोपेतं endowed with characteristics, समतालसमन्वितम् endowed with perfect rhythm, शुश्राव he heard, रामचरितं the deeds of Rama, तस्मिन्काले at that time, पुरा previously, कृतम् composed.

40022345.author: Translation
40022345.content: At that time, he heard the previously composed deeds of Rama, which were endowed with the rhythm of string instruments, accompanied by actions in three registers, refined, characterized by rules, and perfectly rhythmic.

40022346.author: पदार्थः
40022346.content: तानि those, अक्षराणि words, सत्यानि true, यथावृत्तानि as they happened, पूर्वशः formerly, श्रुत्वा having heard, पुरुषशार्दूलो the tiger among men (Rama), विसञ्ज्ञो bewildered, बाष्पलोचनः with tearful eyes.

40022346.author: Translation
40022346.content: Having heard those true words, which recounted events exactly as they had formerly happened, Rama, the tiger among men, became bewildered with tearful eyes.

40022347.author: पदार्थः
40022347.content: स he, मुहूर्तमिवासञ्ज्ञो as if bewildered for a moment, विनिःश्वस्य having sighed, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, तस्मिन् in that, गीते song, यथावृत्तं as it happened, वर्तमानमिवाशृणोत् he heard as if it were happening in the present.

40022347.author: Translation
40022347.content: For a moment, he remained as if bewildered, sighing repeatedly, and in that song, he heard the past events as if they were unfolding in the present.

40022348.author: पदार्थः
40022348.content: पदानुगाश्च and the followers, ये who, राज्ञः of the king, तां that, श्रुत्वा having heard, गीतिसम्पदम् excellent song, अवाङ्मुखाश्च and with downcast faces, दीनाश्च and distressed, हि indeed, आश्चर्यमिति "this is a wonder", च and, अब्रुवन् they said.

40022348.author: Translation
40022348.content: And the king's followers, having heard that excellent song, became downcast and distressed, exclaiming, "This is indeed a wonder!"

40022349.author: पदार्थः
40022349.content: परस्परं to each other, च and, ये who, तत्र there, सैनिकाः soldiers, सम्बभाषिरे spoke, किमिदं what is this, क्व where, च and, वर्तामः are we, किमेतत्स्वप्नदर्शनम् is this a dream vision.

40022349.author: Translation
40022349.content: And the soldiers present there spoke to each other, wondering, "What is this? Where are we? Is this a dream vision?"

40022350.author: पदार्थः
40022350.content: अर्थो a meaning/thing, यो which, नः by us, पुरा previously, दृष्टः was seen, तम् that, आश्रमपदे in the hermitage, पुनः again, शृणुमः we hear, किम् what, इदम् is this, स्वप्नः a dream, गीतबन्धं a song-composition, श्रियः of beauty/fortune, भवेत् it might be.

40022350.author: Translation
40022350.content: They wondered if what they were hearing in the hermitage, which seemed to be a previously seen event, was a dream or a beautiful song.

40022351.author: पदार्थः
40022351.content: विस्मयं wonder, ते they, परं great, गत्वा having reached, शत्रुघ्नम् to Shatrughna, इदम् this, अब्रुवन् said, साधु properly, पृच्छ ask, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, वाल्मीकिं Valmiki, मुनिपुङ्गवम् the foremost among sages.

40022351.author: Translation
40022351.content: Filled with great astonishment, they said to Shatrughna, "O best among men, please properly ask Valmiki, the foremost among sages."

40022352.author: पदार्थः
40022352.content: शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, तु but, अब्रवीत् said, सर्वान् to all, कौतूहलसमन्वितान् filled with curiosity, सैनिकाः O soldiers, न not, क्षमः capable, अस्माकं for us, परिप्रष्टुम् to inquire, इह here, ईदृशः such (a thing).

40022352.author: Translation
40022352.content: But Shatrughna said to all the curious soldiers, "O soldiers, it is not proper for us to make such inquiries here."

40022353.author: पदार्थः
40022353.content: आश्चर्याणि wonders, बहूनि many, इह here, भवन्ति occur, अस्य of this, आश्रमे in the hermitage, मुनेः of the sage, न not, तु but, कौतूहलात् out of curiosity, युक्तम् proper, अन्वेष्टुं to inquire, तं that, महामुनिम् great sage.

40022353.author: Translation
40022353.content: Many wonders occur here in this sage's hermitage, but it is not proper to question that great sage out of mere curiosity.

40022354.author: पदार्थः
40022354.content: एवं thus, तत् that, वाक्यम् statement, उक्त्वा having said, च and, सैनिकान् to the soldiers, रघुनन्दनः Shatrughna, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महर्षिं the great sage, तं that, स्वं his own, निवेशं camp, ययौ went, तदा then.

40022354.author: Translation
40022354.content: Having thus spoken that statement to the soldiers, Shatrughna then saluted the great sage and returned to his own camp. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकसप्ततिमः सर्गः ।। 71 ।। Thus ends the seventy-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
